data.title: Write 8bit/BRANDING.md: arcade-palette Zelda-style playable link level (arrow keys move player, up at a door follows the link)

data.body:
REVIEW (fresh-context reviewer, agent:claude-fable-5-reviewer): PASS — no changes needed.

Checked: (1) Plan vs deliverable — 8bit/BRANDING.md delivers every plan item: three laws + affordance law + voice, 16-token NES-quantized palette as :root block, computed contrast table with hard rule, pixel system (integer scaling, --px, SVG data-URI tiles / box-shadow sprites), Press Start 2P via @import, sprite/tile vocabulary, full level+controls spec, steps()-only motion with reduced-motion rules, anti-goals table, concrete §9 for the generator. (2) User requirements all present: arcade-cabinet palette framing, arrow-key (plus WASD alias) tile-stepped movement, Zelda-style top-down walled room with ASCII collision map (verified 16x11, all symbols in legend), links as labelled doors, Up on threshold fires anchor .click() so the browser navigates natively, and doors stay real <a> elements with click/tap/Tab+Enter fallback and SR note. Link targets match the canonical three used by liquid (github.com/malls, twitter.com/forrestalmasi, mailto:_@forrestalmasi.com). (3) Build-contract compatibility — verified against root CLAUDE.md: @import at top with no raw ';' in URL (single weight), keydown/focus/blur listeners on a tabindex=0 stage inside root (no window/document handlers), root never styled, no commas in functional pseudo-classes, non-scrolling by construction, standalone boot SITES['8bit'](document), :root token block (build rewrites to wrapper). The eightbit- prefix instead of literal 8bit- for ids/keyframes is a justified, documented deviation: CSS identifiers cannot start with a digit, and the prefix still satisfies the contract's document-wide-uniqueness intent (decision was in the plan). (4) House format matches memphis/liquid: same 9-section skeleton with identical §1/§2/§8/§9 anchors, named palette tokens, contrast table, what-this-is-not, page application. (5) Recomputed all 18 WCAG ratios from hex — every table value matches to 0.1 (e.g. #FCFCFC vs #0A0A12 = 19.22 vs claimed 19.2; #F8B800 vs #14143C = 9.91 vs 9.9; #0058F8 vs #0A0A12 = 3.52 vs 3.5). Internal geometry consistent (48px HUD + 176px playfield = 224). Nits only, none blocking: §3 uses 256x224 where the plan sketched 256x240 (doc is self-consistent); §5 describes 3x2-tile structures while the map marks single doorway tiles (map is explicitly normative-in-shape). Meets all acceptance criteria; ready for done.
